core_findings.result: The continuous embedding index is finite by restriction to the dense number field. A local embedding at p!=ell is impossible; at ell it fixes Q_ell, has finite image, maps integer and maximal-ideal elements to norm<=1 and<1. The common compositum and its norm<=1 ring are literal subobjects of the specified Qbar_ell. Coordinate norm equivalence yields finite Z_ell-generation; the maximal-generator norm argument proves the DVR property and ideal-power inclusion. All embeddings use the same iota, whose continuity is not used.

The lattice N_nu(K) intersect P_O is finite free, spans after clearing denominators, and is the exact integral polynomial kernel by injectivity. Left substitution and determinant unit powers preserve it. Saturation proves m^kP intersect N=m^kL, including negative determinant twists. Row-weight projections preserve both the K-kernel and ambient monomial lattice, so their free summands give an actual integral weight basis. HP1 gives its coefficientwise base change to the unchanged complex nablaSq.

Read HP1-HP2 directly: simplicity is proved over every characteristic-zero K and after field extension. The reversing matrix carries the actual highest polynomial to a lower-unipotent-fixed lowest vector. Density of the Gaussian cell N+ T N- and regular matrix coefficients show its upper-unipotent orbit spans the full space. Elementary root operators only add nonnegative positive roots; strict height proves the unique lowest weight, antitone weight inequalities, unipotent lowest row, and common total weight. This supplies the basis facts needed later without an arbitrary-domain standard-monomial theorem.

The tensor basis is on exactly the original algRep factors and maps psi_e=iota composed with j. Its explicit coordinate map is the literal IsAlgWt intertwiner. The tensor index set is nonempty, so dimension=d+1 and index0 can be chosen as the lowest tuple. Expanding source algPow (finite-support product over the full continuous embedding set) and lowW=lambda reversed gives exactly the stated chi identity for every original torus tuple.

All original quantifiers are preserved: every prime, rank n>=0, arbitrary finite V and places S (including places with no continuous embeddings), dominant integer weights, fixed algebraic field isomorphism iota, and original starting coefficient datum. The allowed c<=cprime extension and explicit intertwiner are exactly the existential source endpoint; a different integral basis does not change that representation.

int_N.finding: The exact N lies in the integral matrix group. The actual phi_e sends both the matrix and its inverse into GL_n(O), and the saturated lattice is stable.

integral_torusCharacter.finding: All matrix entries on the compact torus, not just chi, lie in the range of the specified O-to-C map.

int_Nm.finding: Nm(0) lies in the actual integral GL_n; c0=0 is a legitimate original witness.

int_P.finding: The original positive monoid has antitone integer uniformizer exponents. Subtracting the lowest weight gives a nonnegative exponent in each embedding, so every normalized diagonal entry is an actual O-element; off-diagonals vanish.

row_N.finding: Every upper unipotent raises positive-root heights; no other weight can produce a lowest coefficient and that coefficient of the lowest vector is preserved. Tensoring gives the full original Nf row.

torusAction.finding: The integral basis consists of row-weight vectors. All diagonal torus elements are diagonal in this basis, with the exact lowest-coordinate value chi.

nilpotent_central_action.finding: At the fixed original z, every nonzero tensor column has a strictly positive height difference in at least one factor. Its normalized diagonal entry contains a positive power of the image of the actual local uniformizer, which lies in the actual coefficient maximal ideal. All other entries in that column are zero; the required condition is entrywise.

cont_Nm.finding: Nm(c) is congruent to1 modulo local m^(c+1). Taking c=k, local maps carry m^k into coefficient m^k; saturation gives (rho(g)-1)L subset m^k L. Tensor products preserve the exact identity-matrix congruence. Includes k=0.

continuous_torusCharacter.finding: The same exact congruence for Tc(k), then its00 entry, gives chi(t)=1+x with x in the actual coefficient ideal power. No topological continuity of iota is assumed.

central.finding: A central diagonal tuple is scalar componentwise (rank0 and1 included). Every factor weight has the same total sum, so every diagonal coefficient equals its lowest value chi and every off-diagonal entry vanishes.

limitations: This establishes the literal wtRep supplier with all ten fields. It does not by itself prove SpecIntIff.spec, choose its finite-order torus character, supply its single-map all-level assembly, or close the same-ideal Hida/arithmetic specialization producer. No new Lean replay is claimed.
